test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, FROLIC is written as ROLIFC and LOBSTER is written as TSROLEB. How will MANGROVE be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f7ee7b0352a00035c25da1c284e87f1ca4a909f5bf77c7f52573ed754ea93ec.png] 

FROLIC is written as ROLIFC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c66064b60a79e01b1fd24d93ef942fbdbeba5d43a7f4e321c1d9ef3704e09e7d.png] 

and

LOBSTER is written as TSROLEB.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2b0f75ea89c675126e3a85201e3b35fb4018c54571da18aa5c52881a415eba9.png] 

Similarly,

MANGROVE will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96d09f89784d659018b464b97f3c7db128e6495576134b8c74a44d4dadaa2ebe.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"VRONMGEA".**
